row.final_message:
`slugify` now follows your rules, and the tests pass after my last change (8 passed, including the 3 original tests, which I left untouched).

What I changed:
- **`slugify` in blog.py:** it lowercases the title and turns whitespace into hyphens. It then drops every character that isn't a-z, 0-9 or a hyphen, collapses repeated hyphens into one, and trims hyphens from both ends. "What's" gives `whats`, and "Q&A: Why?" gives `posts/qa-why.html` through `output_path`.
- **tests/test_blog.py:** I updated my earlier punctuation tests to the new rules. I also added two cases: repeated hyphens (`-- a --- b --` gives `a-b`) and accented or non-Latin letters ("Café Ünï" gives `caf-n`, and "日本 Post" gives `post`).

Things to know:
- **Accented letters:** they are dropped, not converted. "Café" becomes `caf`, and a word made only of non-ASCII letters disappears.
- **Empty slugs:** a title with no a-z or digit characters, such as "日本" or "?!", now gives an empty slug and the path `posts/.html`. I didn't handle that, since you didn't ask. I can add a fallback or an error if you want one.
- **Duplicate URLs:** two different titles can still produce the same URL, for example "Q&A" and "QA". Nothing checks for that.

Nothing is left for you to do unless you want the empty-slug or duplicate handling added.

diff --git a/blog.py b/blog.py
index d3a7114..a13663e 100644
--- a/blog.py
+++ b/blog.py
@@ -13,8 +13,17 @@ def read_post(text):
 
 
 def slugify(title):
-    """URL part for a post title."""
-    return title.lower().replace(" ", "-")
+    """URL part for a post title.
+
+    The result contains only lowercase a-z, digits and hyphens. Whitespace
+    becomes a hyphen, every other character (punctuation, accented letters,
+    other alphabets) is left out, repeated hyphens become one, and the result
+    never starts or ends with a hyphen.
+    """
+    slug = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", title.lower())
+    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "", slug)
+    slug = re.sub(r"-{2,}", "-", slug)
+    return slug.strip("-")
 
 
 def output_path(meta):

 def test_output_path():

+
+
+def test_punctuation_removed():
+    assert blog.slugify("What's new? A/B tests: part 1!") == "whats-new-ab-tests-part-1"
+
+
+def test_repeated_and_edge_separators():
+    assert blog.slugify("  Hello,   World --  ") == "hello-world"
+
+
+def test_repeated_hyphens_collapse():
+    assert blog.slugify("-- a --- b --") == "a-b"
+
+
+def test_non_ascii_letters_removed():
+    assert blog.slugify("Caf\u00e9 \u00dcn\u00ef") == "caf-n"

+
+
+def test_output_path_with_punctuation():
+    assert blog.output_path({"title": "Q&A: Why?"}) == "posts/qa-why.html"
